div.div: Each workload is a pure kernel plus a thin adapter, compiled once into a content-addressed component. The runner mounts inputs and outputs, reads heartbeat lines from stderr, uploads checkpoints and artifacts, and maps the exit code to a failure class. A resumed attempt starts the same guest with the last checkpoint.
